input.title: The Narrow Channel — Iran fires on ships in the Strait of Hormuz
input.text_summary: Democracy Now! headlines, 2026-07-07: Iran fired on two ships in the Strait of Hormuz amid the Iran war. Shipping was disrupted and insurance/gas prices fluctuated worldwide within hours. Emotional center: a quarrel far away makes everyone's bread more expensive — the world's sustenance flows through one narrow channel, and wrath closes it. Guardrail: live conflict involving real nations; this reading is pattern-level only, no party judged, no side taken.

sequence.phrase: a quarrel flares — wrath enters the marketplace, the shipping lane, the world
livelihood thins; the channel narrows — insurance spikes, gas gets pricier a world away
the hinge: not answered with more wrath, but met with peace — a free choice, not a rule of nature

chain.gloss: anger/wrath (ka'as) — the emotion of rage; in lm1:68 human anger rooted in Gevurot sharing a source with money ("from the north"), and in lm1:18 God's anger (kaʿaso) expressed as concealment of the Divine face
parnasah — livelihood/material sustenance: the provision of food and one's earthly means of support, granted by God (the noun פַּרְנָסָה, including suffixed forms like פַּרְנָסָתוֹ 'his livelihood')

Peace (shalom) — the spiritual quality of harmony that unites and reconciles opposites (e.g., chasadim and gevurot, mind and speech, disputing parties), associated with Yosef, Da'at, and healing; not a greeting, payment (shillum), or completeness (shalem) in another sense

Prayer (tefillah, תְּפִלָּה) — the devotional act of addressing God in praise and petition, the 'service of the heart' (standing worship / the Amidah's eighteen blessings), identified with faith and the power to change nature; NOT the homograph tiflah (תִּפְלָה, 'unseemliness/folly') or tafel ('unseasoned')

bridges.note: the hinge (sequence slot 2, status unknown): the descent (I:66, anger damages livelihood) does not resolve into the ascent through any graph edge — the map attests no cause from a harmed state into peace. The turn is the person's free choice, named as such; segment 0 closes in LM I:66, segment 1 opens a new teaching, LM I:14.

both halves are individually attested and tmap-chain-verified complete (I:14: shalom -> tefillah-2; I:9: tefillah-2 -> parnasah) — split only because each hop's home teaching differs (I:14 vs I:9), not because the chain has a gap. c:tefillah-2 is the shared anchor across both, so the penalty is near-zero.

narrative: A war has narrowed shipping through one strait — and gas is pricier a world away because the fighting there is choking off supply. Rebbe Nachman, the 18th-century Hasidic teacher, already said that: anger damages livelihood, plainly, as its own law — where wrath rules, sustenance thins, in a household, a marketplace, or a shipping lane (Likutey Moharan I:66). It's the same narrowing at every scale: not a verdict on this war, just the pattern it's running on.

Study mode (not part of the public because-formula narrative, cut 2026-07-10): the ascent opens in Likutey Moharan I:14 (cost 0.12): through peace one merits prayer — a builds/presence eitza edge. Peace is the hinge's fruit; prayer is what peace makes possible.

Study mode (not part of the public because-formula narrative, cut 2026-07-10): the ascent closes in Likutey Moharan I:9 (cost 0.12): as one sustains his Father in Heaven with prayer, so is his sustenance given to him — a builds/presence eitza edge that returns the arc to the very concept the descent damaged, parnasah, closing the chain.
process_notes: Rejected: c:machloket-shammai-ve (only machloket concept; deg 1, wrong register — dispute-for-Heaven's-sake); c:milchamah-war-defined (deg 4, no useful parnassah chains); c:tzedakah-power-opening / c:segulah (II:4 "charity widens all openings" — tempting for the strait image, but its openings are entrances into divine service, not parnassah; using it would stretch the gloss — rejected on faithfulness). Missing-concept observation: the story's central image, מיצר/strait (and צינור/channel of shefa), has NO concept in the map — the min-ha-meitzar move was unavailable; candidate for future extraction. Discovery loop that worked: polarity-filtered edge scan on the harmed outcome (harms edges touching parnassah) surfaced c:ka'as -> parnassah instantly — for news, query the harmed OUTCOME first, not the actors' actions. Ascent found via `why c:shalom c:parnasah-livelihood-material` (top chain cost 3.2, both hops attested). Runner-up ascent kept for alternates: tefillah alone (I:9) without the shalom front-link — simpler but loses the hinge (peace as the choice). Writer-supplied-image flag: "channel," used twice in the public narrative (once flagged inline with "as I read it," once bare in the takeaway), is a bridge image the writer supplied to connect the story's strait to the attested shalom->tefillah->parnasah spine — no map concept exists for מיצר/strait or צינור/channel-of-shefa, so neither use is attested; it rides on the honesty of the "he would say" line, not on any proof text. Query-honesty note: the naive direct query `chain c:shalom c:parnasah-livelihood-material` (skipping tefillah-2) returns {"attested": false, "complete": false} — this file never claims that direct hop; the published spine correctly routes shalom -> tefillah-2 -> parnasah, both legs individually tmap-chain-verified complete and attested. Hinge honesty: sequence slot 2 (the turn from wrath to peace) is deliberately status="unknown" with no candidate resolution — the map attests no edge from a harm state to a builds state; the turn is the person's free choice, carried only by the bridge note, not by any graph hop.
